By eye, two passes: every one of the 45 models' base-colour maps (53 maps) on 5 contact sheets at 512 px, then again at 0.75 to 2 times at 1k (14 sheets, then halves and zooms of every map that carries print), with the marked ones in the original-beside-clean pages; the approved pictures pawnbroker_day, _night_lit and _night_dark searched at full size: no legible maker's name (a pale two-word plate on the till's drawer and a red roundel dot on a cassette player are seen as unreadable smudges at 2048 wide); the new pictures searched at 4096 wide after the build (see the notes)
